description:
Let any AI agent use your iPhone or Android phone from your computer, with you in the loop.

Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent.
- You can now delete a single task from Activity: choose Delete in its More actions menu. Its steps, approvals, screenshots and screen recording are removed from this computer. A running task can be deleted once it ends.
